verifications.claim: The 2026 Men's March Madness tournament is available on CBS, TBS, TNT, and truTV.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'CBS Sports and Turner Sports will air all 67 games of the men’s tournament across CBS, TBS. TNT, truTV'; R3: schedule lists games on CBS, TBS, TNT, truTV; R4: 'The men's games will be on CBS, TBS, TNT and TruTV'; R6/R7 similar.
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly state or show via schedule that the men's tournament airs on exactly these four channels.

verifications.claim: All games of the 2026 Men's March Madness tournament can be streamed via the March Madness Live app.
verifications.label: AMBIGUOUS
verifications.evidence: R6: 'watch every game... Watch All Games in the March Madness Live App'; R7: 'CBS games aren't available in the app. That means this is really only a good option through the Elite Eight.'
verifications.reasoning: R6 supports streaming all games via the app (with provider login), but R7 explicitly states CBS games are not available in the app, creating contradiction.

verifications.claim: Paramount+ streams CBS games of the 2026 Men's March Madness tournament.

verifications.reasoning: Sources directly confirm Paramount+ streams CBS March Madness games.
